title: Urgency in minutes
header_line: Jose's analysis of a book we are still naming. Not a summary of the book. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the author or publisher.

lines.text: Do your weeks fly by with the important things undone?
Jose said that on a Monday the question is what the first things are that your mind will engage in, and that one of his morning rituals is to start with it.
A student said: for the business, minutes or hours; the weeks seem to fly by. I accomplish my goals, but I also want to make sure I am living.
Jose said that he has a number in his head by December and a financial goal to reach, and that he has to visualize, plan and structure, and create the urgency in seconds, minutes and hours.
He said that creating a deadline for today means that you say: I have the next four or five days, and if I make this many calls and proposals, I am in the possibility of reaching it.
He added that it is the discipline of the minutes, hours and days, and that some people have other priorities in life that they do not want to let slip.

exercise.title: Five minutes
steps: Write your number for the end of the year.
Write what it needs this week.
Write the other priority you protect.
